'phags mchog gang gi zab cing rgya che'i bla na med pa'i bka' lho ba dbo ngas 5)na gzhir bzung / bka' da spro ngas zhabs 'degs kyi cha shas tsam bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin pa nas/ 17da kyi dpe mdzod khang gi spyi khyab dbu 'dzin khro gling dge bshes lhag rdor mchog gis/ rab gnas shing bya lo 'dir 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog bod lo'i dgung lo bdun cu don gcig dang / phyi lo'i dgung lo bdun bcur phebs par gzhis byes bod mi yongs dang / 'phags mchog gang gi lce sa 'bangs su gyur pa'i 'dzam gling skye bo kun gyis gus bsu'i dga' ston zhu ba dang chabs cig 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du 7zhabs pad do ji'i chos bdun gyi ngi gar brtan cing 'tsho gzhes gsal zhing bzhugs pa'i rten 'byung zhu sgo lo 'khor 'khyud mor srung rtse zhu ba'i dus bzang 'dir/ bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi dpe deb gang mang zhig par bskrun zhus dang zhu 'char sku/da khongs/ 'khan ston dpal 'byor lhun grub (1561—1637) 7zhabs
do༅༅/ /kyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i chos 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod stong ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'di nyid/ ma phyi ngo ma par bshu bgyis te par skrun da spro sa rgyur yang / bgres zad che bas par gzhi gsar 'don zhus na 'jug pa bde ba 5wang nges dang / de yang 'di ga rig gzhung gces skyong gi lte gnas la dra/nga chad lhag med par gzab nan da spro sa gal gsungs pa bzhin/ chos 'byung 'di'i ma phyi mkhar sna bsam gtan gling lgi spar ma zhig sman dge bstan 'dzin mtha' yas lags kyis g.yar son byung ba/ da sngon lbo bzang shasnri lags kyis btsun ma nor 'dzoms la gam pu ṭar gsar 'jug bgyi ru bcug pa/ bstan 'dzin dbyangs can la bskyar sgrig bgyi ru bcug ste/ rtsaba'i ro na gyi 'gangs dang snyu da tshig rnams ma phyi 5war gnas sku nga bar 'bad bsgyu na zhus 5wad pa nas/ ma phyir par lha na du mig tu lnga gas pa dag ༄wad tshig brda'i dbang gis ma dag rgyun 'byams
su 'bo/ rgyur nyen che bar ro nga / brda dag sga bstan bcos dang 'o/da yig lag bltar gyi sku/la rgyun bzang po gnas slad bgyis khul tshig ba༄was zhus par gug rtags bzhag rtsa ba'i dpe gcig ma 'di nyid rang las gzhan mnyam bsdur zhu yul ma phyi gnyis pa med stabs dogs gnas ma chod pa dag ma phyir ro ra bzhag zhus pa'i lnga ga dbu 'dzin dge bshes lhag rdor mchog gis bskyar zhib dag bsher gnang ba dang bcas/ bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gis/ dga' ston legs tshogs rten 'byung du par bskrun zhus par/ 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang wa mchog 7zhabs pad rdo ji'i chos bdun gyi ngo bror brtan cing / chos srid nyi zla'i snang bas gangs ljongs rgud pa'i mun tshogs zhi zhing 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon kun zhi bde'i dpal la spyod pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu dang / zhar byung chos 'byung 'di nyid khungs btsun par bstan pa'i slad mdzad pa wa'i rnam thar snying bsdus btus par/ 7 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub ( 1561—1637) 7— ni/
do༅༅/ /lha btsan po 'od srung gi gdung rgyud nang so rgya ri ba'i mnga' 'bangs su gyur pa/ e'i skyong mkhar zhes pa'i grong du/ yab 'khon rigs sngags rnying ma bka' gte ra mtha' dag la gsan rgya che zhing / grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por phebs pa slob dpon tshe dbang nor rgyas dang yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'phra ma'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyal sna/ 'dzom gnyis kyi sras su/ rab byung dgu pa'i lcags sna/ bya 'o/ra sku 'khrungs/ ('bras ljongs bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug khang gis 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum rtse zhol spar ma bskyar bskrun zhus pa'i (nya)pa'i 'khon ston rna ma thar nang / rab byung bcu pa 'khod pa spar skyon yin/) btsas ma thag nas hrīḥdang dhīḥ'adren pa sku/gas dam pa'i phruld tshul gsal bar byung / dgung 'o/ bdun brgyad tsam nas yi ge 'bri klog bslabs par dka' tshegs cher med par mkhyen/dgung sku/ bcu par rgyal ba bsku/da nams rgya mtsho mjal te/ ma gcig grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang ka thugs rje chen khra'i ༄/ma lung sku gas chos 'brel zhu gnang mdzad/ dgung sku/ bcu gsum skabs nas
yab slob dpon sdo ji 'dzin pa las/ rgyud sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po/ de'i 'grel pa g.yung ston gyis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ sgyu 'phrul skor gyi 'grel ṭīka rnams la gsan bzhes mdzad pas/ lam 'di nyid la brten pa'i mkhas grub chen 'o/ra gyur/ dgung 'o/ bcu bdun skabs thams cad mkhyen pa bsku da nams rgya mtsho'i 47zhabs las rab tu byung ste mtshan bsod nams rnam rgyal du gsol/ spyan ras gzigs kyi skyes rabs dang / slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob grub chen pad+ma badz+ra sa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po gas dngos su gsan pa'i tshe dbang nye brgyud rnams gsan/ dgung lo bco brgyad skabs/ khu bo sngags rnying ma'i rtogs ldan gangs kyi seng ge 'dra ba'i lhan du/ slob dpon chen po dngos kyi lho ba ma gnubs nam mkha'i snying ngo'i rnam 'phrul/ rig 'dzin chen kro nyi zla sangs rgyas pa'i drung du/ theg pa rim dgu'i yang ba rgyud sde kun gyi ga༄ chub/ rdzogs pa chen 5lha ying gsal snying thig ces 'gro 'dug gling pas spyan drangs pa'i
༄༅༅/ /gter ma'i dbang lung khrid man ngag dang bcas pa gsan pas/ sngon gyi bla na med pa'i bag chags kyi mthus/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po rang rig chos kyi skur ngo 'phrod/ gzhan yang drag po rang byung rang shar gyi dbang 'bring po/ ma 'ongs lung bstan sogs lto byang gi gter mnyi dbang lung du ma dang / don tig 'gro ba kun grol gyi dbang lung khrid man ngag kun mkhyen rin spro che'i theg mchog mdzod kyi bshad lung / bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i chos skor/ khug pa lnga'i ngo sprod sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bka' gter man ngag rnams gsan te thugs nyams su bltar bar mdzad pas/ 7spro nga sa lnga pa chen 5was/ ma rig sprin gyis rang sems nyin sna ra byed/ /bsgribs pa'i 'khrul pa'i 'bo 'di'i rang mtshang rnams/ /༄/na pa'i chos tshul 'di ko kun tu bzang / /ma ba༄was rang sar grol ba'i gzigs mor yengs/ /tha mal snang zhing zhen pa'i dod 'phrul kun/ /sems kyi klong du dag pas gang shar rnams / /chos skur to la tshe tra
ro tsa na de/ /'gyur med bde ba'i dbyings su zhi bar mnal/ /a ti'i chos tshul yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /rmad byung khro yis cig car 'thung ba na/ /ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba'i sems klong man ngag sde/ /glegs bam mang por grags kyang gtam du zad/ /ces sogs bsngags par mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu par/ shar phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me dwags po grwa tshang du phebs/ mang thos mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan rin po che/ 'ol kha ba byo bzang rgya mtsho'i drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ grwa tshang du sgrigs zhugs/ bsdus grwa la ched gnyer ma dgos par rang shugs kyis mkhyen tshul mdzad/ phar phyin gyi bskyar chos yongs rdzogs tshar gnyis/ dbu ma'i bskyar chos tshar 'ga' tsam dang tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'dug mdzod sku gas kyi gzhung 'grel kun la lnga sa bsam phyag du byung ba mdzad cing / rigs lung gis mtha' chod par gnang / de ltar yang / rje nyid byams chen chos rje dang / rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyis mthus/
༄༅༅/ /ser byes grwa tshang du phebs/ chos rje dpal 'byor lhun grub dang / 'phrin gas lhun grub gnyis kyi zhag snga nas/ 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang / rje lbo bzang grags pa yab sras kyi legs bshad rnams kyi snying khur bsgril te 'grel ṭīka ga༄ ༄ngar gsan/ gling bsre grub par mdzad/ chos mtshams su pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i dbang / phyag dor 'khor chen gyi dbang sogs spyi chos dang sgos chos ci rigs par gsan bzhes mdzad/ rtsed thang chos sder ris su ma chad pa'i rigs smra 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i grwa skor mdzad/ dgung lo so bzhi par dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi gzims khang rgyal khang rtser/ chos rje dpal 'byor rgya mchogs mkhan 'od dang / chos rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis slob da5wan mdzad/ dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu tshogs tshang ba'i dbus su yongs rdzogs dge slong gi dngos po mnos/ mtshan dpal 'byor lhun grub tu gsog/ 'dug ba'i bslab bya chen mo dang / 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum sogs
kyi bshad lung gsan bzhes mdzad/ 'di dag la lnga pa chen 11sa/ mkhas ma〉〉ga 'chi med lam gyi 'phang pa nas/ /rnam dag tshul khrims gang mārga la chags pa'i/ /bla 5/sa mtshams sprin gsar pa'i lus phra ma/ /thar pa'i bde la spyod phyir 'khyud ga brel/ /nyes spyod rnyog pa'i 'dam las cher 'phags pa'i/ /bag yod sdong bu rnam par ldem pa'i rtser/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyis 'dab stong 'dzum pa de/ /thub bstan rkang drug 5wangs kyi dga' ༄wan gnas/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu ma gsum grangs ldan gyi/ /ches phra'i spang bya kun gas mi 'da' ba'i/ /gtsang ma'i rnam par thar 'dis 'dren pa khyod/ /gangs ri'i ljongs kyi nye bar 'khor du nges/ /zhes bsngags par mdzad/ de nas gsang sngags 〈 snyu theg pa phyi 'gyur gyi skor la thos bsam mdzad pa'i dgongs 'dun mngon du gyur te/dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang du phebs/ 'chad nyan gas thog pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang las/ 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ṭī ka'i bskyar lung / rim lnga gsal sgron/ bskyed rim rnam bshad/
go༅༅/ /rim lnga'i dmar khrid kyi sgom lung / khrid lag rjes/ rgyud kyang le'u bcu gsum pa'i yan dang / le'u bcu drug pa'i 'gyur byang bar gyi rtsa 'grel mchan bcas/ de dag gi mtha' dpyod/ bstan pa spyi rnam bskyar lung / 'grel pa bzhi sbrags sku ngas rdzogs/ rgyud phyi ma/ dngas pa lung lta na/ lha mo bzhis zhus 'od chen 'khos kyi 'gyur la rgyal ba 〈rgang kha pas zhus dag gnang ba ro/gas gsan/ bla ma'i zhal nas kyang rang re'i smad rgyud kyi dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gzhung lugs 'di la/ lda ༄ 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar mi dbar khyis ma chod cing byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba zhes spro ba yang yang bskyed gnang bar mdzad/ dgung 'o/ ga gcig par/ gangs ri'i snyu ngas kyi rigs pa smra ba mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas dpal gsang phu rje'u thog grwa tshang nyi ma thang gi 'chad nyan slob dpon du phebs/ lo lnga'i bar bskyangs pas 'chad nyan 'phel che zhing / mdo phyogs gcig pur ma zad/ tha snyad rig pa dang / chos 'byung lo rgyus sogs gsungs pas/ phal cher la
1/na med pa'i legs bshad du gyur/ dgung 'od zhe lnga'i skabs ser byes mkhas mang grwa tshang gi chos khrir phebs pas 'chad nyan shin tu 'phel ba'i grags snyan gyis 〈tshags mtha'i mkhas pa du ma byes su 'dus pa byung / chu yos lor 'bras spungs gzims chung nyi 'od du 7paṇa chen khro bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ do rje 'phreng ba/ sgrub thabs rgya mcho7 dra gas kyi dbang bka' gsan skabs/ thams cad mkhyen pa sku/na tan rgya mdog/ coms rje dam 〉〉sa dpal/ gzhu khang rab 'byams pa ro gas bshes gnyen mkhas grags mang wa'i kho da nas/ rje 'di par/ ris med bstan pa'i khur 'dzin du thugs gtsigs che zhing / gzhung lugs kyi dka' gnad mang por dri ba'i tshul gyis dogs gcod kyang gnang mdzad/ skabs 'di shed rgyung gsang ba snying tso'i bshad srog sngar ches dar yang / phyis skor rim gyis nub par/ byang bdag rin spro ches/ chos rje ga rma gu ru la/ gsang snying gi bshad rgyun yod med dri ba gnang bar med zhus par/ khyed gdung rus sogs gang sa
༄༄khya/ /nas e yod bsam pa yin zhes gsung lci ba phebs pa thugs la brnags/ de sngon nas yab rje lda ༄ 'dzin pa las sgyu 'phrul gsang snying dang / 'grel pa g.yung ston gyis mdzad pa/klong chen pa'i phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ sgyu 'phrul gyi stor 'grel ṭīka rnams la sbyang bar mdzad pa na/—— gsang bdag sgro phug pa chen spro'i bag chags sad cing / lam 'di nyid bsten pa'i mkhas grub 'gran zla bral bar snyan par grags pas na/ brag sna chos rje 'od rgyan bstan 'dzin ched gnyer gyis se rar phebs te bla brang du bca' sdod byas/ chos thog skabs brtsi bzhag da lnga sa gzhi rdzogs rjes chos thun re dang / chos mtshams kyi tshe gzims chung du gnang ba sku gas g.yung 'grel gyi steng nas zhib cing mtha' chod par gnang grub pas/ le'u lnga pa yan gyi zin bris kyang bzhugs sku da par gsal bas/ rgyud gsang ba snying glu'i bshad rgyun ma nyams pa yang rje 'di'i drin du 'khums/ khyad par gsang snying gi sgo nas chos grwa chen 5wa dpal rtsed thang du grwa skor gyi slob ston gnang bas/
snga 'gyur la rgyud bshad med dam snyam pa'i log rtog thams cad kyang bsal/ gdan sar gling bsre byed sla ba'i stabs kyis mig ltos shig gangs par brten/ gling bsre byed khar dbu phar gnyis la dam bca' nyi ma gsum re dang / 'dul bar nyin gcig 'jog dbo sa pa'i sgrigs 'dzugs gnang bas/ dga' 'bras kyi grwa tshang gzhan rnams kyis kyang / de la dpe byas nas sgrigs 'dzugs gnang ba bcas ris su ma chad pa'i bstan rgyun la bka' drin lhag par lci/ gzhan yang phyogs mtha'i dge bshes du ma 'dus te dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod dri gan mtha' dpyod gnang tshe/ sku tshe hril 'o/ra rgya gar gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis rjes 'brang bcas pa dang / bod yul gyi cha gtsang sku/gas kyi bstan bdo〉sa kho na la sbyangs pa mdzad pa zhig yin par 'dug snyam pa'i mtshan nyid pa mtha' dag gis ston par 'dzin/ rgyud stod smad kyi mkhas pa rnams 'dus te/ rgyud sde bzhi'i skor la rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab dang bstun pa'i gzabs bshad kyis gsang sngags kho na la sbyangs shing
do༅༅/ /mkhas pa yin par 'dug snyam pa dang bcas te lda ༄ slob dpon chen spror byed/ rang gzhan gyi sgom chen dbu ma/ phyag rdzogs/ zhi byed/ gcod yul ba sogs du ma drung du 'du ba rnams la sku/ so'i gegs sel 〉wags 'do na dpyis phyin par mdzad pas/ tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i rtogs pa'i don ma lnga na du gyur pa zhig yin par 'dzin/ sgrub 'phrin phyag bzhes don du gnyer ba rnams la ni/ lag len gyi dka' gnad phra mo rnams kyang mdzub btsugs su ston pas/ rwa lo 'a ba rdo rje grags dang / bse ston nyi ma bzang po lta bu'i rig sngags 'chang ba dang mtshungs par lta/bde sprod snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig pa ba rnams/ la ni/ 'phags yul gyi tsan+d+ra go mi dang / bod yul gyi dpang lo tsā ba slo gros brtan pa lta bu'i rnam thar ston par mdzad pas/ mdor na shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i sgra bshad rje 'di nyid la tshang bar ma lnga na/ gsan bzhes mdzad pa yang gong ltar thams cad mkhyen pa bsku da nams rgya mtsho/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bka' gter
gyi bdag po yab rje 〈 snyu 'dzin pa/ 7paṇa chen lho bzang cho sa rgyan/ rig 'dzin chen po nyi zla sangs rgyas/ byang bdag po yab sras/ jo nang kun rnying sogs ris su ma chad pa'i bshes gnyen dang / ku su lu pa bcas bcu phrag bzhi gas lhag pa rnams kyi 7zhabs pad bsten pa ni/tsho to ga legs pa'i shes rab kyis lam khar dge bsnyen zhig la co〉sa zhus pa'i rnam thar bzhin dang / dam pa'i chos kyi phyir du snying stobs kyi brtul phod pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i mdzad pa dang mtshungs pas/ bod gangs can ljongs su bzhugs so cog gi gzhung chen mos gtsos ris su ma chad rnga'i dbang lung man ngag bshad khrid kyi rim pa rnams 7rje 'di pa la mi mnga' ba med pa lta bur mngon/ de nas/ pha bong kha'am sku mkhar ma ru zhes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam spro'i dgongs bzhed ltar bzhengs pa'i co〉sa rgyal nyid kyi sgrub gnas dang / chos rgyal blon 'bangs bcas nas lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi co〉sa gtsang ma bcu drug gi bka' khrims bcas te/ 'o/da gzhung 'bangs
go༅༅/ /dga' bde'i 'tsho ba'i gzhi tshugs par mdzad pa'i sgrub gnas 'di nyid 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis bod chos ldan zhing gi lugs zung mdzad 'phrin la 'pho 'gyur yong gi yod par brten/ rgyal bstan dang skye 'gro'i bde skyid la dgongs te/ dgung lo nga dgu'i skabs pha bong khar phebs bzhugs gnang ste/ thugs dam spros bcas kyi rim pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil dang / 〈 snga 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ yi dam pad+ma yang gsang sogs rgyud sde che rigs ji snyed dang / gsol 'debs chos spyod kyi rim pa/ ga༄ ༄khur spros med 'od gsal snang bzhi'i skor la thugs dam gyi mthig du bltar/ thugs dam gyi 'o/gas 'don dang bstan 'a spro ra sman pa'i ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung bar gsal bas/ dus skabs de nas bzung / dmar spro'i rtsub spyod kyis ma brdzis bar/ bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i lugs zung gi chab srid dkar 'jam yug gcig tu khyab brdal brtan lhing byung bar rten 'brel gyi khyad gnad cig yod par go 'di
la 7gong sa lnga pa chen 5was/ phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /bsil ldan rgyal por shar ba sku nga btsan rjes/ /sgrub pa'i bsti gnas byang chub shing gi kho da/ /lnga da 'bangs phan dang bde ba'i rtsal ga mchog /gzhan phan khur 'khyer sems kyi mdog lnga pas/ /khyab bdag 'kho ra lo'i dbang phyug nyin mor byed/ /dben gnas 'chi ba med pa'i nal ma yangs por/ /drangs tshe gangs can bde ba'i pasnra 'dzum/ /zhes sogs bsngags par mdzad gnang / de ltar 7sku che 3la 5war ris med bstan pa'i srog shing du rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel gsum chos tshul chos bzhin gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad de/ rab byung 11 pa'i me glang hor zla 8 pa'i tshes 11 nyin zhing 'di'i mdzad pa'i tha ma bstan te/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim/ gsung skyes kyi slob ma yang 7gong sa lnga pa chen spro/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ dpal 'byor 'phrin gas rab rgyas/ brag sna ci rje o rgyan pa sogs bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba'i skyes chen/ bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong spel ba'i gdan
༄༅༅/ /sa pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu byung bar snang / bstan 'gro ༄sa su skyong ba'i gsung rtsom yang / 1 dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro tshul gyi gdams pa zab mo 7snyan brgyud khyad par gsum ldan/ 2 dpal 〈 snyu 'jigs byed kyi 'phrin gas bzhi'i sbyin sreg byed tshul/ 3 sman bla bde gshegs bdun gyi dbang chog phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ 4 thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bla ma mchod pa'i rnam bshad/ 5 byang gter thugs sgrub kyi ma lnga na phu gas gsar ma ltar sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mchog bum bskyed dang sbrags pa/ 6 rgyal ba ro/nga kha par 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs tshul brdas bcings pa'i 'grel pa slo bzang da spro ngas rgyan/ 7 ser byes grwa tshang sga phur pa'i 'od rgyus/ 8 bde ba can 〈snan lam gyi 'grel pa ro/gas ga ro/la 'debs lce/na lam zhal gdams dri lan gyi rigs dang / 99 bstan ba༄was mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka shin tu rgyas pa/ 10 rgyal tshab rin 5wa che'i rnam
bshad kyi dkongs don lhug par ston pa gangs khrod kyi phar phyin yig char ltos par legs pa zhig 11 shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi dgongs don phyin ci ma 'o/ga pa dpal ldan zla ba'i zhal lung ltar/snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa ༄7nga kha pa chen khra'i bzhed pa ji bzhin du gsal bar ༄/na pa'i zab sna/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ 12 phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba spyi khyab lnga sprod pa'i khrid yig 13 rgyud gsang ba snying to/ g.yung 'grel gyi steng nas bka' khrid stsal skabs kyi le'u lnga pa yan gyi zin bris/ 14 gsang 'dus kyi 〈snan lam/ 15 tha mchod ṭīka 16 sa gsum ma/ 17 rab gnas kyi ro/gas dpyod/ 18 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag 19 pha bong kha'i dkar chag 20 mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo zhes thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kyi rnam gzhag 'gran zla med pa'i legs par bshad pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi dzā ti'i skor nas ljags rtsom 'phro can zhig 21 mi tī brgya rtsa'i dbang chog gsal ba'i sgron me/ 22 chos 'byung 'di nyid bcas rnam thar dad pa'i ljon shing /
༄༅༅/ /gu bkra'i chos 'byung / bstan rtsis kun btus bcas su gsal ba ltar bto da pa lags/ skabs 'dir ched du gsol rgyur/ zhu ba 'od blo spro sa kyi 'jug pa zhen ches pas nyes pa'i tshogs mchis pa dag dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar 'chags shing bzod par ga ro la ba lags na/ sgongs par mi 'gyur bar ga ro la ba 'debs shing / gzhan yang zhu sgo par skrun gyi khur 'gan ltar ma 'grub pa dag la rang re'i mche'i rig gzhung gces skyong la sman pa'i legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char yong ba zhu rgyu bcas/ bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi bod yig par skrun sde tshan nas zhu sgrig pa ༄wa mang ngag dbang lung sna gas pas gus pa chen 5was rab gnas shing bya zla tshes la bris//
༄༄༄/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i chos 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod slong ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//
༄༅༅/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul gas rnam par rgyal ba'i mgon/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan 〈 snyu sems dpa' yi/ /'phrin gas bzang spro'i gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /sna rje 'dzin pa'i gtso khyod rgyal gyur cig /rdo rje 'chang gi gsang ba'i mdzod phye nas/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi legs bshad nor bu'i 'phreng / /bskal bzang gdug bya rnams la 'doms mjad pa'i//bla ma brgyud pa'i chos 'byung bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud kyi skor rnams ston pas gsungs shing bla ma rnams kyi rgyud (brgyud )pa'i rim pa ji ltar bshad pa la gnyis/ dang por ston pas gshed skor gyi rgyud rnams gsungs tshul lo rgyus kyi rnam par bzhag pa dang / de las rgyud de (brgyud te ) bla ma brgyud pa bar ma chad
go༅༅/ /du byon pa'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ rwa pa snga ma rnams la grags pa bla ma bha ro nas brgyud pa'i lugs bshad pa dang / dgra nag gi rtog pa bco brgyad pa las gsungs pa'i tshul bshad pa/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel nas gsungs pa ltar gyi lugs bshad pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam dpal lda ༄ dang gshin rje'i gshed lho ra gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yab sras gyi (kyi )bzhed tshul 'od/ /dang spro ni/ bla ma bha lnga nas brgyud pa'i gtam rgyud yin zhes smra ba la 'di ltar 'chad de/gnas rgya gar lho phyogs so ma rir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 〈 snyu 'jigs byed chen po yab yum gyis 'khor lha bcu gnyis brten (rten ) dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen
po sprul nas rgyud 'bum pa/ gdug bya dbang phyug chen po 'dug ba ga dgongs te gsungs so/ /de yang ji ltar brtul (btul )zhe na/ lha dbang phyug chen po dang / dbu ma gnyis kyi bu gzhon nu gdong drug dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po ru tra gnyis 'dzam bu'i gling du 'thabs pas/ ru tra rgyal zhing gdong drug pham pa las/ de'i dus su ri rab kyi khong seng lha ma yin gyi gnas na dbang phyug chen 'od sku da pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du rang gi bu pham par shes te/ 'do da khams na che ba dbang phyug yin pas/ des sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i dmag tshogs dang / sa kho ga gi rta pa'i dmag tshogs dang / sa steng gi nad brgyad dang gdon brgyad kyi dmag drangs nas lha ma yin gyi rgyal spro ru tra pham par byas/ de'i tshe ru tras 'phags pa 'jam dpal la skyabs su sku nga bas/ 'jam dpal gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnyen por phyag so bzhi sprul/ sa 'og gi rta pa'i dmag tshogs kyi gnyen por ma he'i gdong pa sprul/ sa steng gi nad brgyad dang gdon brgyad kyi gnyen por zhabs bcu drug sprul/
go༅༅/ /dbang phyug chen khra'i gnyen por mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba bstan nas lda ༄ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum pa gsungs so/ /zhes rwa pa snga ma phag che ba lo rgyus 'di la tshad mar byed kyang / mkhas grub rje'i gsung nas 'di ltar zhi rgyud dang rgya gzhung gang nas kyang zur tsam yang mi 'byung zhing / khungs rnam dag gis kyang yid ches bskyed par byar med pa'i gtam rgyud snga ma dag la tshad mar bzung na mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang legs par 'gal ba'i cal col du ma smra dgos pa 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar legs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgra nag gi rtog pa bco brgyad pa las/ 〈khun pa sangs rgyas do chen gdan la 'o/da la bdud brtul (btul )ba'i mdzad pa lha na pa'i tshe thugs ka nas/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs sprul te bdud brtul (btul )zhing rgyud rnams gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs/ rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa snga ma rnams su/ 'a ji gdan du rnam 'jums kyi rgyud gsungs par bshad pa la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba na re/ de mi 'thad de sdo ji
gdan la 19da la bdud 'dul ba'i gnas yin gyi 〉〉sa 'kho ra ba lho ra ba'i gnas ma yin zhes bkag nas/ kho nga rang ri rab kyi byang shar gyi rtser gsungs par bzhed ro / /stob du ni lugs 'di la skyon 'di mi 'jug ste/ lda ༄ gdan chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas min par 'dod pa ni theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar ma yin na de'i tshe ston pas zhag bdun phrag bdun du chos ma gsungs par bshad pa sgra ji bzhin pa yin na/ chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor ba'i mchog gi sprul sku yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / gshin rje tshe bdag dang 'char kha'i rgyud gnyis las/ de'i tshe ston pas gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud gsungs par gsungs pa'i phyir/ mgos ('gos )lo ma bas rgya gar du gan bcu gnyis byon pa'i phyi ma 'di/ bla ma sprin gyi shugs can la/ gshin rje 'char kha gsan pa ra byon pas/ 'char kha sprin shugs ma zhes mgos lugs la tshad ldan du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ ston pas lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dus 'khor gyi rgyud gsungs nga 'i che/
༄༅༅/ /gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud mtha' dag gsungs par dus 'khor ba rnams bzhed do/ /de'i tshe dpal ge rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro'am/ sna tshogs gzugs can gyi pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyi 〉〉sa 'byung gi nang du/ rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas rgyud gsungs par bshad pa yin te/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi gling gzhi'i skabs kyi bzhugs pa'i gnas ston pa'i rgyud tshig dus 'khor 'grel chen du drangs pa gas/sdo ji mkha' 'gro'i pad+mar gnas/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gcig pu 'di/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin gyis/ /srid gsum bdag nyid dag la gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes drangs pa 'di kyi do rjer dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gas/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying 5༄ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs rna so//zhes pa dang /tshig (tshigs )bcad lhug pa ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig par dus 'khor 'grel chen
gas bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rgyud snyu rje 'phreng ba las/ a ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / /bha ga chos 'byung pad+ma la/ /rnal 'byor seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /mchog tu rmad byung ston par mdzad/ /lda ༄ sems dpa' waṃ lda ༄/ /lda ༄ 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang glu'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /zhes/ ston pa gang la bzhugs nas chos ston par mdzad pa'i rten gzhal yas khang la/ rgyud la gar gsang ba zhes pa dang / la gar mkha' dbyings dang / de bzhin du bha ga dang / chos 'byung dang / pad+ma dang / seng ge'i gdan zhes gsungs pa rnams e yig gi don ston byed du 'du ba dang / ston pa la 〈 rje can dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / do ji 'jigs byed dang / sdo ji dbang phyug dang / he ru ka dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang / dang spro'i sangs rgyas zhes rgyud so sor gsungs pa rnams kyis kyang / waṃ yig gi don ston pa la khyad med cing / de 'dra ba'i e waṃ gi nges don rgyud gang du brjod pa de ga/
go༅༅/ /de nyid mchog yod cing med na med par gsungs so/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro shes pa de ga'ang sna tshogs gzugs can ma zhes bshad de/rdo rje ro gangs ma dang don 'dra la / bde mchog gi rgyud rgyas pa yum phag mos zhus pa ltar/ 'di'i rgyud rgyas pa yang 'jigs byed rang gi yum sna tshogs gzugs can mas zhus par ston pa'i 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rgyas pa'i tshig dus 'khor 'grel chen du drangs pa las/ dpal ldan sna tshogs gzugs can mas/ /do ji 'jigs byed la btud zhus/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa'i byung (rgyud )/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mchog bde zhes (ci )//zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i lugs la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi yum gyi pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyi chos 'byung gi nang du dpal rdo snga 'jigs byed kyi rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas yum sna tshogs gzugs can mas zhus pa'i ra 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rgyas pa gsungs pa/ yum gyis bsdus te yi ger bto/da pa'i glegs bam yu ma sna tshogs gzugs can nam/ mkha' 'do/
seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis o rgyan gyi yul du spyan drangs/ 'di dag gis zhi 〈 snyu 'jigs byed la yum yod par 'bad med du grub ste/ yum med na yum gyi bha ga dang / pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyi chos 'byung du bzhugs pa mi srid pa'i phyir lnga / /bzhi pa ni/ nag 5wa dra ba can gyi rgyud las/ khams gsum 'kho ra ba gshin rje yin/ /chos kyi rgyal 'o rje bo yin/ /ga man ta ka gshed kro yin//zhes gshin rje dang gshed gnyis smra/ smra/ra gsungs pa bzhin du dri ma med pa'i lugs las/ gnas na gnas pa'i yi dwags dang / /lus la gnas pa'i 'chi bdag dang / /sems la gnas pa'i nyon mongs gsum/ /gdul bya las kyi gshin rje yin/ /zhes dang / de'i mus kyang / 'dul byed gshed kyang rnam gsum ste/ /chos kyi sku yi ngo bo las/ /gzugs sku'i ngo bor bstan pas ni/ /gnas na gnas pa'i yi dwags 'dug/ /chos dbyings bde ba'i ngang las ni/ /log lta ga 'khrul pas ma slad cing / /sems nyid lha yi skur snang bas/ /lus la gnas pa'i 'chi bdag 'dug/ /las dang
go༅༅/ /ye shes gnyis med pas/ /sems nyid dag pa'i klong du ni/ /gdul bya 'dul byed gnyis med pas/ /rang la gnas par rtogs pas ni/ /sems la gnas pa'i nyon mongs 'dul//zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la gsum/ gnas na gnas pa'i gshin rje 'dul tshul bshad pa/ lus la gnas pa'i 'chi bdag 'dug tshul bshad pa/ sems la gnas pa'i na shā/ngas 'dul tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang 'o/ la gnyis/ gnas na gnas pa'i gdul bya yi dwags kyi rigs kyi gshin rje bshad pa/ de 'dul phyir du gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas rgyud gsungs tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang yo ni/ gnas na gnas pa'i yi dwags ni/ /gdul bya las kyi gshin rje yin/ /zhes sbrel te/ de yang ri rab chen lnga'i 'og sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yang 'og rgya mchog chen spro'i gting / rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng na las dang nyon mongs pa las grub par lcags kyi khang par/ mi ro gsar snying (rnying )ga sogs pa dang / khrag zhag gi rgya mtshor 'khyil ba/ kha zur
kun rno ba/ phyi sha khrag rus pa thang mar brdal ba'i nang du nang 'dzin pa'i shes pa las 'khrul zhing / las kyi rnam par smin pa drag spro'i mthu gas grub pa'i/ yi dwags/ kyi bdud nag 'od cad ba dgu ring zhes kyang bya/ gshin rje be wa satwa zhes kyang bya ste/ mdog nag 'od gcer bu ral pa can kha gdangs pa mche ba gtsis/sa pa/ lce 'gril ba/ mig rtsa ༄wad pa/ mig sprin dmar ba/ 'bras bu mthing nag 'grig ba la/ rdzi ma dang smin ma bzings (gzengs )pa/ lag pa gnyis dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sems la zhes (zhe ) sdang me ltar 'bar ba de dang / de'i yum las kyi gtum pa'i srin mo gtum mo dug hrul gos gyon ma zhes kyang bya/ tsa muṇ+ḍi zhes kyang bya ba mdog nag mo/ gcer mo ral pa can shin tu khros pa lag pa gnyis ti (thi )shug dang thod rlon khrag dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ sems la 'dod chags chu ltar 'khrug pa gnyis tshogs pa gas/ de gnyis kyi sras bka' sngod gas kyi 'od nya gshin rje chos kyi rgyal 'od dang / sprul pa phya sang (sto bsang )gnyis/
༄༄khya/ /ya ba hi dang tel pa gnyis/ a bo glang mgo dang smag pa gnyis/ rag pa tshar dgu dang mig mar gnyis te brgyad do/ /de'i yum yang mgo dgu brtsegs pa'i rkang rgyal dang / mon mo drod kyi hab sham can dang / mgo dgu brtsegs pa'i rkang gsum ma sogs gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa/ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar zhing 'dod chags chu ltar 'khrug pa tshogs pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la'ang / sprin dmar nag dang ljang nag rab tu 'khrig ('khrigs )pa la brten bcas nas/ srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog sdud par byed pa la ni gshin rje zhes bya ste/ de nyid las/ 'jig rten pa yi sems can rnams/ /to ga ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /log pa'i lam/ la mthu brtas pas/ /'kho ra ba'i sa lnga na rtsub mor smin/ /bdud 'di spyi mthun las kyi bdud/ /zhes gsungs so / / gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi sku yi lnga༄ du las/ /gzugs sku'i 'o bdur bstan pas zhi/ /gnas na gnas pa'i yi dwags 'dul/ /zhes gsungs te/ ba༄wam ldan 'das 'jam dpal thugs ye cas chos

༄rgyab/ /'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma 'ching byed kyi sngags gcig kyang bslabs te/ rgan mo gar song cha med/ phyis rgan mo de yum 〈 snyu bai ta li yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'phra/ ma mang 'od dang phrad kyang / 'ga' zhig tu brda'i gan byas pas btang / 'ga' zhig tu sngags de bzlas pas btang ste 'od rgyan yul du byon/ mkha' 'bo ma rnams la tshogs kyi 'kho ra lo bcwa ra nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi chos skor gsum 'od zhus pas/ mkha' 'bo ma rnams kyis ma gnang bar/ tshogs 'kho ra yang yang byas yi dam la ga5wal ba btab ste/ chos kyi mdzod la bsgor ba byas pa la/ dharmā gha dzha chos kyi mdzod nas gsang sngags kyi glegs bam mang spro phyir spyan drangs te mchod pa byed kyin 'dug slo ba dngo na la khyod dad pa che bar 'dug pas/ rgyud 'di rnams kyi nang nas zhag bdun gyi bar blo la gang zin nga re khyod la sbyin/ zhag bdun nas glegs bam rnams chos mdzod du 'jug pa yin zer/ der slob dngo na gyis zhag bdun gyi bar la blo la bzung
bas chen spro mi zin snyam nas/ na bza' gting (btings )ba'i steng du rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams la bskor ba mdzad cing / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la ga1khul ba btab pas/ zhag gcig smra/nga tsa na mkha' 'bo ma gcig byung nas zhag bdun la gcig 5wang / da drug las med zer/ de bzhin du nyi ma re re bzhin byung nas/ da ni zhag gcig gas ma lus ༄ ༄ra ba la/ zhag bdun gyi lnga rengs su song tsa na do ji 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang / dgra nag gi rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa dang / rgyud rtog pa gsum pa dang / gdong drug gi rgyud sdom pa gsum pa rnams thugs la lam gyi (gyis )byung nas 'dug 'di rnams yin nam ma yin snyam tsa na/ glegs bam rnams kha rang bye ste/ thad ka thad ka na ji lta ba bzhin 'dug pas dad pa skyes rgyud thams cad to la zin par gsol ba btab pas/ nam langs tsa na mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs byon nas/ 'dzam bu gling lgi gdug bya rnams kyi 'o/na byed pa la des 〉〉ga der ma 'dus pa re re tsam
༄༅༅/ /dang dbang byin brlabs dang bcas pa mkha' 'bo ma rnams kyi (kyis )ster bar 'gyur gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas mkha' 'bo ma rnams byung ste/ rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams chos mdzod du bcug slob dpon la khyod snod ldan du 'dug gsungs nas/ gshin rje'i gshed skor gsum gyi dbang rjes gnang dang bcas pa dang / rgyud gsum gyi lung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang / las mkhan te'u lo'i rtog pa gnang nas skyel thung mdzad/ slob dpon gyis rgya gar gyi yul dbus su byon nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs te bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ lda ༄ 'jigs byed kyi sgrubs (sgrub )thabs zhe dgu ma dang ro langs brgyad skor gyi sgrub thabs smra/gas mdzad/ kha gcig (cig )'di 69 rgyan yul du 'khrungs zer yang / rgya gar du 'khrungs nas 6khu rgyan yul nas rgyud spyan 'dren pa spro yin te/ mkhas grub rin spro ches
rgyud 'di snyad rgyan gyi yul nas len pa po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i grub chen lā li ta badz+ra ni rgyud 'di skor la sdud pa po dang 'dra ba'i tshad ma'i skyes bu ste zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lā li ta badz+ra gyis (badz+ra sa )mdzad zer ba'i lta ga bdun gyi 'grel pa zhig snang ba bstan 'gyur dkar chagasu (chag tu )ma tshud cing mkhas pa rnams la ma grags pas dpyad par bya'/ /lha) lugs la 'di dang mi mthun pa'i lo rgyus yod pa brjed 'dug cing / dpe cha dmag gi dus thor ba'i (bas )'bri ma nus so/ /de'i slob ma slob dpon a mo gha badz+ra ste don yod sdo jis/ de nyid ga dbang dang rgyud rna mas gsan te 〈 snyu 'jigs byed kyi zhag gzigs mchog gi da lnga sa grub brnyes nas/ 'jigs byed lha mo brgyad skor gyi sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog de'i sbyin sreg rnams mdzad/ rdzogs rim la phyag rgya la brten nas gtso 'khor bsgom tshul sdo ji tshig 'byed mdzad/ de la grub chen gling ras bas ṭīk+ka rgyas pa zhig mdzad/ 'di a mo gha badz+ra che ba yin nyo/ /de la slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas
༄༅༅/ /sbas pas dbang dang rgyud rnams gsan te/ yi dam zhag gzigs nas da lnga sa grub brnyes dpa' 'od gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ de'i slob ma pad+ma badz+ra ni rig pa'i gnas lnga mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ /khyad par du ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa la gshin rje'i gshed kyi dbang rgyud gdams pa dang bcas pa gsan sgrub pa mdzad pas yi dam gyi zhag gzigs te dngos grub brnyes so/ /de'i slob ma jo ro ye rang pa thugs rje chen spro la mtshan dī paṃ kā ra rak+ṣi ta dang / bha ro phyag bsdum (rdum )pa zhes par yang grags/ phyag bsdum (rdum )pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzhon nu'i dus rgyal tso'i khrims dang 'gal bas phyag bcad de bsdum (rdum )por sku/nga ba yin/ phyi rol pa'i gzhung la sbyangs shing mu stegs kyi rigs byed kyi lha gsang bar smra ba yin pa la/ o rgyan du phyin nas lha/da pa brtsams pas spyod pa bya ma ran par byas pas lha/ bar gyur te/ 6khu rgyan na byin brlabs che ba slob da spron pad+ma badz+ra la byin brlabs dang dbang bskur zhus pas lcum ba bsangs (sangs )/
nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la yid ches te bla ma pad+ma badz+ra la 'o rje 'jigs byed dang phag mo zhag gnyis ma'i lha/ra sku gas mang du gsan/ sgrub pa mdzad pas da lnga sa grub brnyes/ bla ma bha lnga sa rgyal po sing ga ga'i khrims dang 'gal ba byas pas chad pa gcod du sku nga zer ba la/ bsam gtan gyi ༄wags pa la brten rgyal 'od la dbang sdud mdzad pas chad pa'i spro sa pa zhi nas/ rgyal 'od 'kho ra dang bcas pa gus pa 'bul du byung ste spyod pa mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /nā ro pa'i da lnga sa slob mkhas pa chen po pradzñā rak+ṣi ta gas bde mchog sga dbang rgyud gdams pa dang bcas pa legs par gsan to//de nas bal yul tu phebs te sgrub pa mdzad pas do ji 'jigs byed kyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ sgrub thabs kyi bstan ba༄was rtsam pa dang gzhan lnga na gyis shig pa'i gsung gi snang (gnang )ba thob pas/ /bag yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad 'dus pa la nag 'jigs skor gsum gyi rgyud 'grel gdams pa dang bcas pa bshad pas snyan pa cher rgyas nas/ rwa lo tsho ba sogs bod kyi 'od tsho ba mang pos
—༄༅༅/ /kyang zhabs la btugs (gtugs )te bstan ba〉〉sa kyang mang du mdzad/ bstan ba༄was kyi grangs 'og tu rwa 'o'i rnam thar gyi skabs su 'chad/ dbus gtsang gi mthig du yang phebs te ka gsung chos mang du gsungs pas/ gzhan lnga na 'phrin las lhag par rgyas/ slar bal yul du byon yun ring du bzhugs te/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor rnams bal yul dang gangs can gyi ljongs thams cad du rgyas par mdzad do/ /de nas bod du dar tshul zhi/ rwa lo tsho ba lda je grags pa zhi/ gtsang stod snye nam snang yul du rje mar pa lo tsho gas sku cung gzhon par 'khrungs/ 'khrungs nas 'od phyed tsam sku nga nas yum gyi pang du bzhugs pa'i tshe lha mo re ma nyis phu thung nang du khyer nas zla ba gnyis kyi bar du dbus gtsang dang khams mi nyag sga bar gyi sa thams cad bstan/ 'di dag thams cad khyed kyi gdug bya'i zhing du 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan mdzad/ slar yum gyi pang du bskyal nas mi lo lnga cam song ba'i tshod kyi sku chen po zhig tu byin gyis brlabs/ 'bri klog sogs
rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ dus phyis rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par ༄wags/ de nas bag yul du byon zhing bag 5wa thugs rje chen 'od la gdo/ bor brten (bsten )cing / de dang rje nā lnga pa'i dngos lho ba mkhas pa chen 'od pradzñā ra ta des bag 'od thugs rje chen 'od la gsungs/ de la rwa los legs par gsan cing mkhyen pa zhi 'di lta ste/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang saṃ bhu ṭa dang dod rje mkha' 'gro dang rgyud mngon spyod bla ma dang he ru ka sngon byung dang / kun spyod dang phag mo sngon byung dang nag tra chos drug dang bde mchog lu yī pa'i skor gyi gdams pa du ma dang / khyad par du 〈 snyu 'jigs byed kyi rgyud sna ga pa bdun pa dang bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa dang te'u lo'i rtog pa dang / de dag gi 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pa dang gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag gi skor dang gdong drug gi skor dang mtshan brjod rtsa 'grel dang / phag mo zhag gnyis ma'i stor dang bsgom (sgom )gyi gdams ngag dang / par bu dang mgon chung la sogs pa sku ga ser gyi gdams pa
༄༅༅/ /dang bcas pa mkhyen/ bal spro'i paṇa grub gzhan yang du ma la chos mang du gsan/ de nas rgya gar du byon pas chu lnga gang ga'i 'gram du rnal 'byor pa gsum gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor la sgrub pa byed 'dug pas g.yog byas te gdams pa phyag len dang bcas pa bslabs pas mthu stobs nus pa phul du byung zhes bod kyi grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi (gyis )gsung ngo / /gong du smos pa'i gzhung de dag la kha cig la gzhi 'gyur/ kha cig 'gyur bcos te zhu chen gyi lo sde ba mdzad/ khyad par du 'a ji 'jigs byed dang dgra nag dang gdong drug gi rgyud rgya gzhung rnams bsgyur te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ de dag gi yig cha mdzad pa la rwa lo'i gsung nas/ le'u ba༄wa brgyad kun gyi gzhi/ /rgyud kyi rgyal to lha na pas gsungs/ /de'i bo gas su rtog pa gsum/ /bsngags pa'i mtshon char ston pas gsungs/ /sgrub thabs dkyil mchog dpal 'dzin gyis/ /mdzad pa de la gtso ngar bzung / /'khrul 'khor gsal byed bu d+dha shri/ /lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod//
kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig ba༄was/ /zhes gsungs te dgra nag gi lho ra bsgyur tshul dang / de'i gdams pa 'od rje bas mdzad tshul ni/ rgyud kyi chings bla ma rwa 'od tshos mdzad pa/ rgyud kyi yig sna chen 'od rgyud kyi rnam bshad bsdus pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung bsdur te spyi bshad dang / chos bzhi 'chi med nas rnam bshad kyi bar rnams la zin bris chen mo mdzad/ char dbab pa nas lha dang klu'i bu mo dgug pa'i bar gyi gdams pa gser zhun ma dang 'dra ba'i man ngag gas 'a lha zab mo nas pa dang / dpal 'dzin gyi rgya gzhung la brten nas nag spro'i sgrub thabs chen mo dang / yig sna du ma dpal 'dzin gyi dkyil mchog gi rjes su 'brangs te/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi dbang chog dang / yang dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi bsdus don/ sgrub thabs bsdus don/ rnam bshad kyi bsdus don snga ma ni sku gshegs khar ldan rdzong du mdzad/ dgra nag gi skor rwa los mdzad pa 'di dag tu nges te/ bla ma rwa lo'i gsung las/ rgyud kyi chings te khog ston yin/ /yig sna
do༅༅/ /lus kyi rnam bshad yin/ /bla ma'i gsung bsdur phran tshegs rnams/ /ma bo bgegs sel gdams ngag yin/ /dpal 'dzin mdzad pa'i gdams ngag la/ /gsal byed tsam gyi yi ge byas/ /bha ro'i phyag len dpal 'dzin gsung / /de brten dbang bskur gong ma la/ /yig sna bdud rtsi'i bum pa brtsams/ /chos bzhi 'chi med bdud rtsi dang / /mig sman sgrub pa'i gtam rgyud dang / /bsrung 'khor kha sbyor dbye ba rnams/ /gas sgrub 'khor lo phyi ma dang / /rgyas btab bla ma'i bzhed pa dang / /bla ma'i zhal bsdur gtor ma dang / /sa 'og dgug pa'i gtam rgyud dang //bla ma rnams kyi zhal bsdur dang / /he ru ka yi rnam bshad dang / /bar do'i byang chub sems bshad dang / /klu yi rnam par bshad rnams dang / /bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin du/ /zin bris byas nas bla ma la/ /gzigs pa phul te dag par gtugs/ /mnyes nas de tsug yin zhes gsungs/ /las phran ni/ char dbab klu yi nad gdo/nga thabs/ /sprul bzung to/sa dang ma to/ nad zhing / /chu
'gags khyams dang dod gangs bsgrub/ /'phags pa 'dzam bu li sgrub dang / /yum bzhi'i gas tshogs sgrub pa dang / /mig sman rig bu rkang mgyogs dang / /mkha' spyod lnga da pa sgrub pa dang / /sa 'og mkha' spyod mi snang dang / /ral gcig su smra se sgrub dang / /lha dang klu yi bu mo dgug /man ngag gser zhun 'di dag rnams/ /rgyud kyi lhang 'dra bla ma'i gsung / /5wad kyi brnyes yi ger ba'o/da/ /bla ma nyid la gzigs su phul/ /nor 'khrul da lnga sa grub mi 'byung bas/ /lhag chad e 'dug gan gsum zhus/ /rkang thag spangs nas gan gsum phyin/ /bla ma'i gsung nas bu zhes gsungs/ /nor 'khrul mi 'dug lan gsum gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ gdong drug gi skor la rgyud sdom pa gsum pa lo tsho bas mdzad pa'i bsdus don mngon rtog (rtogs )'jug pa dag byed dang dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum chung rnams rwa lo nyid kyis mdzad de/ lo na ba'i gsungs gas/ bshad rgyud sdom gsum ldan pa yod/ /dka' ba'i gnad dkrol yig sna byas/ /bza don gas0ri
do༅༅/ /ba'i sgron me byas/ /mngon rtog (rtogs )'jug pa dag byed byas/ /dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum chung byas/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di las gzhan rwa pa rnams kyi gdong drug gi yig cha mdzad de/ do ji 'jigs byed kyi rgya gzhung skor bsgyur bshad la rtsa ba'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/ te'u lo'i rtog pa dkyil chog a mo gha badz+ra sa mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ tshogs 'kho/ra rat+na a ka ra shā ci pas mdzad pa/ te'u 'o'i rtog pa'i sgrub thabs shrī bha dras mdzad pa zhag gsum phyag drug pa/ zhag gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de dag bla ma bha ros mdzad pa thams cad bsgyur te bla ma'i gsung gas/ snying wa'i rgyud mchog rtog bdun yod/ /las mkhan te'u lo'i rtog pa yod/ /don yod 'a jis mdzad pa yi/ /sgrub thabs dkyil chog sbyin sreg yod/ /rwi paṃ ka ra'i sbyin sre ga yod/ /rat+na a gar shā ca yis/ /mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor 'od yod/ /bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum yod/ /kha cig gsar 'gyur kha
cig bcos/ /zhes gsungs/ de dag la lo tsho bas yig sna mdzad tshul ni/ rtog bdun gyi nag 'grel dka' 'grel man ngag bcud thig (thigs )bsnyen sgrub gas gshin sbrel ba/ lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod/ gtso bo'i sgrub thabs dri med snang ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs khams gsum za byed/ zhag gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs dri med chu rgyun/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen don bsdus/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mi mthun kun sel/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'dod pa kun 'phel/ dbang gi sbyin sreg gnad kyi lcags kyu/ drag ngo'i sbyin sreg dgra bgegs kun 'dul/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de rnams mdzad de nyid kyi zhag nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal 'o/ rtog bdun la/ /gzhan 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen brtsams/ /dka' 'grel phyog (phyogs ) mthong 'ben la gtad/ /bcud kyi thig (thigs )pas phog par bsnun/ /— pa'i
go༅/ /mtshon 'di (de )snying la gab/ /khar rgyud (brgyud )yi ger ma bkod do/ /bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud yod/ /mngon rtog (rtogs )rim pa lnga yang yod/ /gas bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho ga sku da/ /smin byed dkyil chog yig sna 5wad/ /dmar 'o/ mda' gzhu 'gengs pa sku da/ /'di dag rnams ni mi legs na'ang / /ban chung rwa yi lugs su snang / /nga yi rjes 'brangs thams cad kyis/ /bcos slad (bslad )ma byed nyams su longs/ /ba༄was na da lnga sa grub ga la lnga ba/ /'di ru ma bsdus yi ge'i tshogs/ /legs na'ang gzhan gyis sbyar ba min/ /'di yis nyes na'ang gzhan du min/ /gzhan gyi legs na'ang 'di ru min/ /phyogs 'dzin che zhing man ngag bsre/ /rang dang lho ba ma phung ba'i rgyu/ /man ngag ma grub lha la khang ('khangs ) / /de 'dra 5war la lam 'di brten/ /zhes gsungs pas rje btsun rwa los dngos su mdzad pa la de dag las med ngo / /sgyu gas rim gyi skor la rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi man ngag mtshan ma rgyu ba'i man ngag mtshan ma

༄༅༅/ /mdo sde rgyan bshad pa'i le'u bcu ga/sum pa gas/ de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan par rab grags cho rge bzang shes ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /bshad pas skye ro'i nang na nyi ma bzhin du lham/ /zhes dang / ma gcig lab lha na gyi lung bstan du/ bu mo snyu da kyis dris pa'i byang sems de/ /ma 'ongs bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa —yin/ /da lta byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs che/ /snyigs dus log spyod bod yul byung ('byung )ba'i tshe/ /dge slong tshul 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan thogs te/ /gang gi zhing du seng ge'i nga ror grags/ /khrims 'chag log lha da spobs pa zig gnon pas/ /khrims 'chal bag med yang dag khrims la lha ra/ /thub nyid sku la btod bstan pa'i phyag rtags 'dzin/ /bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong lngar / /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa'i bcud phyungs nas/ /gdug byar gyur pa'i skal ldan tshim par mdzad/
ces dang / bskul byang gas/ 'di ltar nyon cig rgyal po dad pa can/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon dus nye bar 'kho ra/ /mya ngan 'das tshe u gu sta (gup+ta )zhes bya/ /grong khyer 'ga' ru bha wa bha drar grags/ /shar phyogs rgya nag yul dang nye ba'i char/ /shākya'i dge slong khro bzang zhes bya 'byung / /rgyal ba'i sras 'od grags pa'i mtha' can des/ /shākya'i rgyal 'od longs lha da snyu gas skur bsgyur/ /pha rgyud zab gnad phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang / /mtha' bzhi spros bral rig pa'i lta ba yis/ /bskal bzang gdug bya mang yo smin bo la mdzad/ /zhing 'di'i sku yi bto da pa legs bsdus nas/ /gro mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten du/ /rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ror mngon 'tshang rgya/ /de yi phyag gi mched sdod la (mchod sdong chen po gas ) / /'od zer bye ba'i phung po rab tu 'gyed/ /ces dang / pad+ma bka' chems gas/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa gdul bya bstan pa'i bdag /mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa zhes/ /mi rabs brgyad du gsang sngags
༄༅༅/ /rgyas par ston/ /zhing 'di 'das nas byams pa'i drung du 'gro /de yi rgyud 'dzin tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin/ /rang byung bskal pa chen po la/ /dgra bcom thob par the tshom med//ces dang / pad+ma thang yig las/ dga' ldan zhes bya'i dbo na gnas dam pa ru/ /mkhas pa'i mchog gyur mdod rgyud don la mkhas/ /khu rje 'chang sprul gsang sngags bka' lha 'byed/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon lam ston sa mkhan zhi/ /blo dang bzang sga mtshan can skyes bu 'byung / /gsang mtshan gas rab lda ༄ bde ba rtsal/ /zhes dang / rgyal po bka' thang gas/ de phyis 'dus pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la / / shākya'i zhing khams 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / /〈snan lam dag pas byang sems gzhan don mdzad/ /'dus pa'i ma lnga〉ga gyur 'phags pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rat+na'i spyi lung chen mo gas/ 'dra rim dbyangs spru la pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa/ /byo gros stobs lngan grags pa'i ming can 'byung / /zhes dang / gu ru chos dbang gi gter yig gas/ 'jam dbyangs sprul
pa to bzang grags pa zhes/ /bstan pa rgyas byed de ni lnga mtshar can/ /zhes dang / nyi zla sangs rgyas kyis slob dpon la zhus pa lung bstan pa ra/ sems skyed thub pa'i drung du bskyed/ /skye ba kun tu 'gro ༄wan mdzad/ /smon lam gcig gi bye brag gis/ /sems dpa' de la smad par byed/ /kye ma sems can snying re rje/ /'brel tshad don ldan snying stobs can/ /sde snod 'dzin pa'i 'khor gyis bcwa/ra/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs bskyed byed/ /snyigs ma'i dus su a la la khri /bde ba can du gshegs rgyu la/ /re zhig byams pa'i drung du 'khri /sems dpa' gser gyi me lta ga grags/ /zhes dang / rje bla ma dang phu gas ldan 'jam dpal rgya mchog/ skal ldan gyi lha lnga drug bcas la 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gsang ba'i me long gsungs pa las/ bya lha da phung po'i rir ston pa sangs rgyas la klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas dung phul ba re zhig chos dung mdzad/ de rjes ston pa 'khor bcas kha cher phebs dus/ da na slob ma dge slong pa d+ma'i ngad 3 na 'di/
go༅༅/ /lnga da gdong dmar gyi yul du lho/ bzang grags pa zhes bya ba'i dge lho nga du gyur nas/ she sa rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / mtho sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed pa 'ong gsungs te/ kun dga' ro la bka' stsal pas/ kun dga' bos sngar gyi dung bsnams nas au 'gal gyi bus rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te/ 'a'o ga ri 'od cher gter du sbas so/ /gter bdag tshogs bdag la ba༄wal bas spre'u'i gzugs su sku da 'od/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ ma 'angs sdigs ma'i dus kyi mthar/ /mtha' 'kho ba kha ba'i yul 3wangs su/ /byo bzang zhes bya'i skyes bu 'byung / /zla med ston pa'i bstan pa dang / /nga yi lugs bzang spel bar byed/ /gdong dmar las can skal ldan rnams/ /myur du smin cing grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyal po bka' 'bum las/ de nas bstan pa'i lhang spro sgrub pa spro/ /byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i dge slong ni/ /yon ta/ na dpag tu med pa'i dam rma 'byung / /gsang sngags mngon ba ra grub pa'i dge slong ni//
dam pa mang 5was bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur/ /de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing skyes chen dam pa zhi//snying spro'i mtha' brten rnal 'byor chen spro des/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur chen bo mdzad/ /de la bsnyen bkur cher byed de dag ni/ /'phags pa'i gang zag dge sbyong sha stag go /de phyir de dag kun la gus pa bskyed/ /de dag ci phyir 'phags pa yin zhe na/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mdzad pa chen 'od mdzad/ /de phyir de dag 'phags pa'i gang zag spro /de ltar bzhugs pa'i gang zag rnams 'byung zhing / /'khor ni legs gnas ston pa'i gsung rab dang / /ston pa'i sku gzugs dngos su gzhugs (bzhugs )pa dang / ri lnga yon tan can yang de na yod/ /ces ngang / 3wa brag mkhar chu'i gnas bshad las/ /tsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs shing / /'gro ༄nan dbus su lha nga bar byed/ /mdo sngags bsngan khrims sku la yang 'byed/ /ces dang / bka' gdams —
༄༅༅/ /glegs bam gas/ bla ma dri ma med pas/ bdag kyang gnas der lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro /zhes slob dpon pad+ma dang / sprul pa gcig ni rgya gar gnas su 'gro /zhes 〈 geg chen po dang /sprul pa gcig ni bal ngo'i mthil du 'bo// zhes paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma badz+ra dang / sprul pa zhig zhi mdo khams smad la 'do /zhes mdod smad du 'khrungs pa 'jam ma spro na bla ma dang / mar me mdzad kyang gnas mchog 'dir/ /sgrol mar bcas te sprul stong 'gyed/ /lhag par chags med bsod snyoms pas/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs bzhi'i gas can dbang du bsdud (bsdus)//nga yi mchod tshogs rgyas par byed/ /mar me mdzad dang byams pa yang / /khyod kyi grogs bzang spel bar byed/ /ring por mi thogs gnas mchog 'der/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'du bar 'gyur//spyan ras gzigs dbang bzang 1khur sprul/ /zhes dang / glegs bam pha co〉sa las/ grags dang yang grags rin chen gyi/ /grags pa'i mtha' bzang dpal du grags/ /slo bo/sa shes rab ga 'an du
gsol/ /gzhan yang grags pa'i mtshan rab can/ /mang pos 'gro ba'i bde skyid bskrun/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ bdag gi sprul pa dam pa gcig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ /des ni gnas de skyong bar byed/ /res 'ga' byis pa'i gzugs su 'ong / /res 'ga' dbul 'phongs sprang spro'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' byol song bya khyi'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' gsog 'debs dbyangs kyi gzugs/ /res 'ga' yig 'bru gzungs kyi gzugs/ /grags pa can gyi dge slong ngo / /bstan gnas bar du yang yang 'ong / /de ni rgyud pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /khrims ldan de yis byin brlabs shing / /skyes bu gsum zhi don gnyer ba'i/ /bya ba myong ba brgya phrag tsam/ /gnas der bsam gtan sgom par byed/ /de ga'ang cung zad lta bas gnong / /'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo 'byung / /bsam gtan chags sdang dag la 'chor/ /lo na kyang sprul pas byin brlabs pas/ /lha dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i gnas/ /bkur 'os nyid du nges par 'gyur/ /ma lnga ra na gnas
kha༅༅/ /mchog de dag tu/ /dang po bzhi grwa nas bzung ste/ /tha mar stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ /bslab pa gsum ldan shākya'i sras/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon du 'gyur/ /gnas der ri phyogs dang 6wags mtshams nas/ /dge 'dun dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /spyir yang las can 〈megs bcur 'phra/ /phyi yi rgya mchog dag dang mtshungs/ /chu 'od brgya yis gang mi nus/ /ci tsam zhig gis dma' ma nus/ /zhes dang / yang / tha mar bstan pa'i me ro dag /grags pa'i mtshan gyis ga'o/ bar byed/ /du ma'i phan bde sgrub byed pa'i/ ṣe yang gnas rim〈snag dam pa yin/ /zhes dang /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lung bstan las/ sngon bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med pa'i snga rol du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang ngo'i tog bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus sga theg pa mchog tu gyur pa lda ༄ theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdza da do/ /de'i tshe rje bdag nyid chen spro 'di nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sras kyi thu bo/ gzungs dang spobs
pa dang / mngon par ri shes pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / bden gnyis ma lnga na sum du gzigs pa dag pa'i ye shes ga sogs pa 5wan tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur dod/ 1de nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs 'khor dang bcas pa de bzhin gshegs pa dbang ngo'i tog 〈 snyu theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i 'dun sar gshegs shing bzhugs pa na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba dbang gu'i tog gis tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ma dag pa'i zhing khams grangs med pa rnams su zab mo dbu ma'i lam dang 'brel ba'i sgyu dro theg pa'i lam bzang lus dang sku ga la mi lta bar rgyas par byed pa de ni/ rgyal sras rnams kyi rlabs chen spyad pa rgya mtsho'i rab dang / phyag dang / mchog tu gyur pa ca / /zhes seng ge'i sgra sgrags (bsgrags )pa na/ bdag nyid chen 'o/ 'di snying stobs ches cher rgyas pas/ 'kho ra tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su bzhengs te/ zhum pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ deng nas brtsams te/ lus dang 19ga la mi lta bar/ ma dag pa'i
༄༅༅/ /zhing grangs med par zab mo dbu ma'i lam dang 'brel ba'i 〈 snyu theg pa'i lam bzang rgyas par bya'o zhes de bzhin gshegs pa dbang wa'i tog sogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dbang du gzhag ste dam bcas shing / bden pa'i tshig sga sgra dbyangs bsgrags 1khu/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dbang ngo'i tog 'o/gas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis legs sku / /khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs chen wa'o zhes dbugs dbyung zhing / de nas gzung (bzung )ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du'ang bdag nyid chen 5 3'i mtshan byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs chen por grags so/ /de nas rgyal ba dbang spro'i tog sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs bye ba dpag tu med pa 'gyed cing zhal 'dzum pa dang ldan pas/ khyod kyis ji ltar dam bcas pa bzhin du / deng nas bzung ste/ ma dag pa'i zhing grangs med pa rnams su mdo sngags kyi dam chos rgyas par byas te/ mthar gyis ngo mchar rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing du/ de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i
nga ro shes bya ba'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur 1ri nas lung bstan par mdzad ro / /zhes dang ka mkhan chen las kyi ro rje la gsang bdag gis lung bstan pa gas/ slo bzang grags pa 'gran zla kun dang bral/ /shākya'i rgyal gra'i drung du sems mchog bskyed/ /zhing 'dir mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung lugs spel/ /'di nas 'phos te dga' ldan gnas su 'gro/ /'jam dpal snying po byams pa'i sras mchog ste/ /myur du 'tshang rgya de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yang gsang 'dzin las kyi lda ༄ la/ lhu/na nas nye bar 'brel ba yi/ /lho bzang grags pa 'di nyid zhi//sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa ste/ /paṇa chen rkyang gi lus bzung nas/ /mdo dang sngags kyi don bshad cing / /nges pa kho na 'tshang rgya'o/ /rgya gar rgya nag bal po dang / /dbus gtsang mdo khams yul phyogs su/ /skye ba bzung zhing 'gro kun rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la khrid par mdzad/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can ma ni las rgya ste/ /nges pa kho nar
༄༅༅/ /byang chub bo/ /'phags pa'i slob ma 'du bar byed/ /lus 'di bor tshe dga' ldan du/ /byams pa'i drung 'gro chos nyan 'gyur/ /'jam dpal snying spro zhes bya ba/ /sems can kun la brtse ba ste/ /de zhi sa bcu'i mthar phyin to/ /zhes dang / yang blo bzang grags pa 'di zhi/ tshogs gnyis rgya cher bsags pa'i ga/nga zag yin te/ skye ba bdun gyi bar du paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshul bzung sems can mtha' gas kyi don byas/ skye ba 'di kha'i snga ma kha che khri brtan gyi yul du paṇ+ḍi ta ma nyi bha dra shrī zhes bya bar 'khrungs te/ phun sum chogs pa'i 'khor lnga brgya 'dus/ so so skye bo'i snang ngor sbyor lam la gnas par grags/ khob nga lag na 'a jis kyang 'di'i yon tan dpas par mi nus shing lhag pa'i lha phyi nang gi lha mos rjes su bzung zhing / rigs gsum mgon pos kyang rjes su bzung ste lhag pa'i lha yin/ sangs nam rgya ngas mi ston/ 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyis lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /ma)wang thos reg gsum gyi phan sku na ༄wab nges pa'i gang zag yin pas
khong gi rgyud tshod gzhan gyis dpag par mi nus 5wa/ /zhes dang / yang dga' ldan du byams pa'i drung du byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal snying po zhes bya bar skye/ de nas 'dzam gling gzhan du sems can gyi don la dgongs te chos rgyal gcig tu skye ba bzhes nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo / /gsum pa 'dzam gling 'dir rgya gar shar phyogs su pu ri tsa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā shrī zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ 'khor nyis stong 'du zhing / 'khor rnams kyang tshogs lam chen po dang / sbyor lam la gnas pa sha stag 'byung gsung ngo / /'es dang / yang byams pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa/ lha mo dbyangs can mas rig pa ster bar byed pa phun sum tshogs pa gcig dang skye ba bco lnga'i gong nas 'brel ba yod cing phan tshun dpon lhob tu 'brel ba zhig 'ong ba yod pas/ de la chos bka' la bsris ma 'jug par byin/ phar yang chos zhus zer ba zhig byung / zhes dang / chos rje don ldib ldan chen pas/
༄༄khya/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dang yang yang mjal bar gsol ba btab pas/ 'jigs byed kyi zhal nas/ sang phod da tsam lung pa 'di'i mda' ru yong / de bar du bde bar gyis gsungs pa/de gang yin dpyad pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ khyad kyi bur 'dug pa thigs (thegs )pa yin gsungs nas yi dam gyi bris sku byin brlabs can 1/gas ched bdu skyel mi btang ba yin/ zhes dang / gsang bdag gi lung las/ dbang bskur ri yi ldebs dag tu/ /btsun mo ri yi ngos phyogs su/ /dge 'dun dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /ri ni byang yin 'jam dbyangs 'chad/ /dbus gtsang ma'o/ khams rgya yul gyi/ /ma〉〉da gnas dam pa tshogs ga sku ga rten/ /mnga' ris ma5) smad kun gyi skyabs/ /47gas bcur rdze das/na rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / glegs bam las/ shar nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes/0 /zhes gsungs pa sogs gong gsal rnam dag bka'/ zab gter/ dag snang bcas tshad thub kyi lung don sding po ngo bo rdo rje 'chang dang
'jam dbyangs 'jigs mdzad rdo rje/ snang ba mtha' gas sogs yin par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang / nged cag rigs gsum mgon po zhes/ /so sor bstan kyang ngo bo gcig /zhes nges ngo na rigs gsum mgon por gsungs pas/ bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal 'od las kyang ches snga bar sangs rgyas zin par bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan des na/ rje bdag nyid chen 'od 'di'i gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa mkha' khyab 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su skad cig re re ga'ang rgyal ri ba'i mjad pa bcu gnyis cig char dang rim pa can du mar ston par mdzad cing / srid pa ji srid bar 'bo/ ba rnams la gang 'dul gyis 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa 'bad med lhun grub du (tu )'jug pa'i tshul dang / 'phags yul du byang sems nyan lnga sa paṇa grub rgyal blon 'o/gas ci rigs par bstan tshul/ de mtshungs phyogs 'dir yang sku'i bto da pa bstan tshul sogs sku/ngas su grags pa'i lung bstan 'di dag gas rje 'jam dpal snying ngo/'i mthun mongs dang mthun mongs (thun mong dang thun shā/nga ) ma
༄༄khya/ /yin pa'i sku na tan gyi cha'i rnam par thar pa rags rim rnams shes par 'gyur ba'i byed por mchis pas 'dir phyogs cig du (gcig tu )bkod pa yin la/ de gas gzhan pa'i rnam par thar pa khyab ches pas ma bris so/ /ring brgyud de ltar dang nye brgyud rje bdag nyid chen por gshin rje'i gshed spros/ rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon sum du dbang bskur bar gsungs pas rje nyid nas brgyud chog par gsungs so/ /'dir smra sa pa/ dpal ldan rgyud rgyal gshin rje (rje'i )gshed kro yi/ /chos 'byung nor bu'i 'phreng gas stod cha dang / /'jam mgon bla ma lung gis bstan tshul bcas/ /chos sbyin spel slad mkhar kor par du grub/ /dge 'dis tshe rabs 'phreng bar yi dam lhas/ /mi 'bral rjes bzung rim gnyis myur bsgro de cing / /blo bzang grags bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /'gro kun bde skyid ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ sarba mar+sha la ཾ // ༈ rje btsun tsong kha pa zhi mdo smad shar tsong kha'i yul du rab byung drug pa'i me mo bya'i lo la mal gyi

༄༄khya/ /sku/gas gsan te dga' ldan pa'i bshes gnyen chen por kun la grags/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho zhi chu mo sku sa la rta nag tu 'khrungs/ rje gshegs pa'i lo bzhi pa yin/ kun mkhyen mkhyen rab dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ kun mkhyen sku sma tan rgya mtsho/ lo tsho ba shes rab rin chen/ chos rje blo bo sa chos lha nga / chos rje chos grags pa rnams la dus kyi 'khor lo cha lag dang bcas pa dang mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mang du gsan/ khyad par du chos snyu blo gros chos skyong la rje'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi bshad lung gsan/ chos rje pa la mkhan po dang paṇa chen shākya shrī gas slob/ rong ston blo bzang par gsang ston zhus nas dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'chad nyan la spyan 'dren mang du byung yang rin chen sgang du phebs nas grub (sgrub )pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pas lam gyi rim pa thun mong ba dang / thun sna/nga ma yin pa'i bde lha nga gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'a༄rig pa'i ༄wag :(༄wags )pa'i sku na tan mtha' gas

༄༄khya/ /mkhyen pa bsku da nams rgya mchog sku gas skyid shod kyi mchod yon thams cad kyi bla mar gyur/ de la 〈 snyu 'chang rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos legs par gsan pa yin te/ de ni nyang stod du lcags mo glang la 'khrungs te dpal 'khor bde chen du rab tu byung / bkra shis lhun spro shar rtse paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros dpal bzang la dka' chen rnams gsan te dka' bcu grwa skor mdzad/ dben sar rgyal ba phyo bzang don grub drung du mdo sngags kyi lam rim rnams dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi zab khrid sogs mang du gsan pas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ gan cig bla ma'i zhag nas dka' bcu pa rang bkra shis lhun par byon la pu ti lhag ma rnams bslabs la rab 'byams grwa skor mdzod dang rje'i bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen spro 'a byung bar 'dug gsung / de nas bkra shis lhun por gsan sbyong ma lus par mdzad/ ngam ring dang dpal 'khor bde chen du grwa skor mdzad de dpal 'khor bde chen gyi lha khang grwa tshang sga bla ma mdzad/ grwa khang gi zhig gsos mdzad pa'i
tshe sa men pa sna ba'i phug pa gas nas 'bo ma nus par/ rje'i gsung nas khyed rang rnams sa bto sa ngas bzung gi gsung nas phyag pa'i sa mtshams su zhabs bzhag ste ting nge 'dzin brtan spros mnan pas phug pa ma dib/ de nas grwa pa rnams kyis phyir thon pa dang zhabs bsdus nas byon pas phyag pa zhig kun ngo mtshar bar gyur/ paṇa chen rig pa pa'i drung du mkhas grub rje dang rje blo gros chos skyong ba gnyis kyi 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs sku ngas su snyu gas pa bshad lung gdams pa dang bcas pa gsan/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi lung gsan pas sngags kyi slob gnyer la thugs bzhed che bar 'khrungs te dga' ldan du phebs/ rje byams pa rgya mtsho'i drung du gsang ba 'dus ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris 'dzin pa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka le'u bcu bzhi pa'i bar du gsan/ bskyed rdzogs chen mo gnyis kyi bshad lung khrid lag brjes (rjes )man ngag dang bcas pa gsan nas 'grel pa'i bshad pa zhus pas/ rgyud smad du smra/nga gsungs nas rgyud smad kyi chos grwar 'od gsum byon te/ rje dge bab go
༄༅༅/ /rgyal mtshan gyi drung du 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi zhib bshad lung dang bcas pa tshar gsum gsan/ zhabs bsnyung nas mthar rgyas su 'o/ gcig bzhugs rin (ring ) ga de'i mchod gnas gnas brtan par rgyud 'bum gyi lung bzhugs 'dug pas kho nga la gsar ma rgyud 'bum sku/ngas to gas tshar gcig legs par gsan/ gtsang la byon te gser sdings kyi rgyud kyi 'chad nyan mjad/der snga sor ṭīk+ka 'grel gyi srol mi 'dug kyang ṭīk+ka 'dzin pa dang 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad pa btsugs pas/ gtsang phyogs kyi dge bshes thams cad 'dus te 'chad nyan 'phel zhing blo bskyed che/dbus su dga' ldan du phebs te mchod chung la rgyud stod smad gser sdings pa dang gsum 'dzom pa la dge bshes gser sdings pa bzang bar 'dug ces snyan grags kyang che bas rje byams pa rgya mtsho dang sde pa bkra shis pa mchod yon gnyis kyis rgyud smad kyi 'chad nyan gyi zhu ba phul te/ zhal bzhes mngo da nas gtsang la bteg ste zhag snga nas/: bkra shis rin chen pa la grwa chang tsho rbe glang lo la

༄༄khya/ /'dod yong gsung phebs pas gang 'dod rnyed/ zhag ba'i dus su sa men pa ma rnyed bas rtsa ri'i ri 'di'i rigs la sa men pa gang 'dod yod gsungs nas zhal snga nas rang gis btsal te rnyed/ bdag gis kyang sa men pa phogs gnyis len du phyin pa'i tshe/ sa khru gang tsam bsna sa phyin ri thams cad sa men pa'i rang bzhin du 'dug pa mngon sum du mthong yang da lta ji tsam bto sa kyang sa men pa mi 'dug zer/ dod rnams la phyag brjes (rjes )zhabs brjes (rjes )byung ba sku gas ya mtshan pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ gur smon du 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ logs bris rab gnas kyi bar legs par gsar du grub/ rgyud kyi 'chad nyan kyang de dus (wa na 'phel te chu mig lung du ṭī klu'i bskyar co〉sa le'u bcu bdun pa'i mtshams sbyar kho na la chos 'tshams (mtshams )mdzad/ rgyud 'grel ni phra ro bzhin du sku ngas su phyu gas pa mdzad/ thugs rje dang 'phrin gas che bas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang dgu thams cad rgyud

༄༅༅/ /gang gā'i 'gram du phebs pa dang / nga ngan pa yin pa chu la reg tu mi btub pas chu khyod kyis lam phye zhig ces bsgyu da pas chu ngo gyen la log ste gram pa skam shar gyis byung ba la gshegs pas dge 'dun gyis grub thob tu shes nas bzod par ga ro la/ wā rā na 'a lo gcig ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa sku nyi lhags gis (kyis )brdungs pas sku mdog rmug ( smug )po 'jigs su rung bar gyur/ der mu stegs pa dang sangs rgyas pa the tshom nas rgyal 1khu smyon nan ta tsakra bya ba des/ mu stegs pa yin na tso rgyal te 'ong bas nang du spyan 'dren sangs rgyas pa yin na wā rā na 'a gnod pa bskyal dogs yod pas bskrad dgos pas rtogs shig (rtog cig )zer/ brtags pas ma rtogs te rgyal spro'i drung du khrid shog zer khrid nas 'ongs pa'i rul ma du/ 'bu dang phye ma leb la sogs pa srog chags mang spro khar bcug pas mi rnams na re ngan pa zer/: kha nas gsos rbe sdur bas kyang ngan pa zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis/ srog chags mang po bsad kyang ngan pa zer//’
sku/ga chags mang wa ga ro/sa kyang ngan pa zer/ /bdag gi ji ltar bya ba ma shes sku / /zhes gsungs/ rgyal ngo'i drung du slobs pa dang rgyal pos phyi nang gang yin dris kyang lan ma btab/ rgyal pos 'di la dbang phyug gi rtags gang yang mi 'dug pas/ lcags su chug la chu la bskur cig byas te/ de ltar byas pas lcags sgog chad nas rgyal ngo'i rtsar slebs/ yang yang byas kyang de ltar gyur pas/rgyal bos grub lnga ba tu shes nas ba lnga da par ga ro la te 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas par byas so/ /de nas lha phyogs thi ma ha ra zhes bya ba 'dul bar gshegs pa'i lam du chu ro gang gyur to/ mkhan la sgrol gsungs pas/ gru bla (gla )dbo sa zer/ gru blar (glar )chu rang byin he spyan tu log nas thams cad skrags ( skrag )nas nor bu phul ba gru blar (slar )byin pas ma mdod par zhabs la 'jus te bdag rjes su 'dzin par zhu byas pas/ rjes su gzung (bzung )grub thob ko ka li'am tsho he ru ka zer/ de nas lho phyogs thi mo sa ra dang nye ba na dha ki zhi btab pa zhes pa'i chang tshong ma zhig dzi— khrim
༄༅ba/ /du slebs/ dpon slob gnyis kyis chang nyo byas pas rin ci yod zer/ rin med byas pas rin med par chang tshong ba'i lugs med zer/ nged ngoms pa gyis dang khyed ci 'dod pa byin gyis gsungs pas/ ji tsam na ster zer/ nyi grib mtshams su ri mo zhig bris nas 'di 'das ma thag ster byas/ nyi ma lte (gte )mar bcug pas chang blud/ zad pa dang rin blangs byas pas da dung nyi ma ma sku nga smra nga ba dang ster gsungs/ des yul de'i chang chogang ma kun la bskyis bskyes byin pas zad/ rgyal gu'i dbyug tshod dang chu tshod brtsis pas 'khrugs/ mi rnams kyang gnyid kyi (kyis ) ra 1ri bar gyur pa dang / rgyal sku/sa rnal lte 'byar pa gcig gis nus pa bstan par spro nas rtsad bcad pas chod de/ der 〉〈ngas nas nyi ma gtong bar zhus pas chang rin med gsung / rgyal pos rin sprad pa dang mtshan phyed du gyur to/ /kha gcig zhag phyed dang bdun song zer ro/ /de nas lho phyogs na ra sa ti'i yul na thi ma har zhes bya ba dbang phyug chen ngo'i ling ga 'jigs go go bgo
